tuition.note: Total for 3 years, Bachelor of Business (Honours), 2026 intake, excluding 6% service tax; fees reviewed annually

requirement.text: SPM/O-Level plus Pre-U/Foundation with 5 credits including Mathematics and English (or a Diploma with 3 credits); English proof such as MUET Band 3, CEFR low B2 or a Pre-U/Diploma taught in English. Intakes: February, April, September.
